WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE PARTNERS OF ZUI INVESTMENTS
The undersigned, being the partners (“Partners”) of ZUI Investments (“Partnership Firm”),
hereby consent to and adopt in writing the following resolutions as of this 31st day of December
2020:
Resolved that, Mr. Hasan Danish bearing CNIC No. 37405-7579458-5, be and is hereby
authorized, directed, and empowered to act as the duly authorized representative of the
Partnership Firm to collect the allotment letter of the real estate project named and styled as
“Zameen Ace Mall”, located at Plot No. 36A, Sector J, Phase II, DHA Islamabad, Pakistan from
Defence Housing Authority Islamabad – Rawalpindi and sign, execute, deliver, and complete all
instruments and documents, and to do all such acts as may be necessary and/or proper to effect
the purposes mentioned hereinabove.
